title: COBRA versus Marketplace after job coverage ends
facts: Loss of job-based health coverage can create a Marketplace Special Enrollment Period, so a person may have a choice between COBRA and Marketplace coverage.
COBRA usually preserves the existing group plan but may require paying the full premium; Marketplace plans have separate networks, benefits and potential income-based savings.
Voluntarily ending COBRA early generally does not automatically create a Marketplace Special Enrollment Period; exhausting COBRA or another qualifying event can have different rules.
COBRA interactions with Medicare have special coordination and enrollment consequences and should not be treated as ordinary employer active coverage.
